import random, socket
random.seed(42)
# 200000 FIB records with varied prefix lengths
seen=set(); lines=[]
while len(lines) < 200000:
    l = random.choice([0,16,24,32,40,48,56,64])
    b = bytes(random.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(16))
    if l==0: norm=b'\x00'*16
    else:
        mask=((1<<l)-1)<<(128-l)
        norm=(int.from_bytes(b,'big')&mask).to_bytes(16,'big')
    key=(int.from_bytes(norm[:8],'big'),l)
    if key in seen: continue
    seen.add(key)
    lines.append("%s/%d %d" % (socket.inet_ntop(socket.AF_INET6,norm), l, random.randint(0,4294967295)))
open('/tmp/t/big.fib','w').write("\n".join(lines)+"\n")
# 1M trace
with open('/tmp/t/big.trace','w') as f:
    for i in range(1000000):
        b=bytes(random.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(16))
        f.write(socket.inet_ntop(socket.AF_INET6,b)+"\n")
print("done")
PY
